note: Provides one Views display plugin, id 'rest_export_nested' (title 'REST export nested', extends core RestExport). Its render() renders via the serializer then decodes any field value that is a JSON string into real nested JSON (json_decode, with an HTML-entity-decoded fallback), and turns the literal 'null' into real null. Typical use with Views Field View to embed a child view's rows as nested JSON. Adds an 'auth' display option. No settings page. Medium/hard read/build a Views display of plugin rest_export_nested on real views (ren_known_view / ren_task_view).

evals.prompt: I have a Views REST feed where one field contains a JSON string that comes out escaped as text. Which module/display makes it come out as real nested JSON, and what display do I add to my view?
evals.expected_output: Use REST Export Nested: add a display of type 'REST export nested' (plugin id rest_export_nested) to your view; it decodes any JSON-string field into nested JSON in the output.

evals.prompt: How does the REST export nested display decide which fields to turn into nested JSON, and what happens to a field whose value is the string 'null'?
evals.expected_output: For every row it runs json_decode() (and an HTML-entity-decoded fallback) on each string field value; if it parses, the string is replaced with the decoded object/array. The literal string 'null' is converted to a real null.

evals.prompt: What is the typical way to embed a child view's rows as nested JSON inside a parent REST export nested feed?
evals.expected_output: Use Views Field View: build a child 'REST export'/'REST export nested' display of the related content, then in the parent 'REST export nested' display add a Views field pointing at the child view/display and pass the host id as its contextual filter; the child JSON string is decoded into nested JSON.

evals.prompt: On this site the View 'ren_known_view' exposes a REST export that supports nested JSON. Inspect the view: what is the display plugin id of that display and at what path is it served?
evals.expected_output: The display uses plugin id rest_export_nested and is served at path 'ren-known' (views.view.ren_known_view display rest_export_1).

evals.prompt: The View 'ren_task_view' currently only has a default display. Add a 'REST export nested' display to it so it can output nested JSON, and save the change to the live view.
evals.expected_output: Add a display with display_plugin 'rest_export_nested' (e.g. give it a path and serializer style) to ren_task_view and save. verify checks the view has a display whose display_plugin is rest_export_nested.
